subject: Re: Kickoff: knowledge-graph-driven forecasting (graph temporal AI)
body:
Anders,

Staffing for the window: Ondrej 70%, Hyun 40%, Saoirse 30%, Emeka 50%, Paloma 40%. That covers the encoder integration and the feedback-ingestion demo.

Looking past the window: Ondrej Bergstrom is committed at 60% to this project for May 2026 to carry the knowledge-graph encoder into the partner pilot, and my pilot plan assumes that allocation holds. He is the only person who understands both the encoder internals and the partner's association-rule format, so I want that in writing now rather than discovered in May.

Compute: modest - 16 A100s best-effort on titan for encoder training. The heavier cost is data engineering: partner meta-data arrives as three different graph schemas and Paloma needs to normalize them before Hyun can encode anything.

One calendar note: I want the pilot-readiness review before 4/15 if possible, since Q2 planning eats the following week.

Bao
